title: Searching for a Device Posture Profile

blocks.text: You can quickly locate a specific device posture profile using the Search field.
To find a Device Posture Profile using the Search field:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > Device Posture.
In the Search field, enter search words and press Enter to display your search results.

blocks.text: To clear the Search field, delete the search term you typed and press Enter.
